iter1_findings_closure.closure_evidence: App.tsx:606 — TabsList className now includes overflow-x-auto. On viewports <375px (e.g. 320px iPhone SE) the tab bar scrolls horizontally instead of overflowing/clipping. Verified via grep.

Library.tsx:213-220 — TSK-046 intentionally renders a branding header (logo img) in all Library states (error/loading/empty/populated) for brand consistency. Explicit comment: 'Renderizzato in tutti gli stati (error/loading/empty/populated) per coerenza branding.' Not introduced by TSK-143. Out of scope.

App.tsx:606 — TabsList className now includes bg-transparent p-0. These override the shadcn base classes bg-muted and p-1 from tabs.tsx:14-15. Tab bar is now flush: no muted container background, no inner padding. Triggers sit directly on the border-b separator. Verified via grep.
Header legacy sd-* classes are outside TSK-143 scope. Documented for EP-020 Phase 2. No action required for this TSK.

open_questions_update.resolution: F-02 confirmed pre-existing (TSK-046). Library branding header is intentional.
Label 'Info & Privacy' retained per TSK-143 spec and product decision. F-01 mitigated by overflow-x-auto rather than label truncation.
TSK-153 (ConfirmGameChangeDialog → Radix AlertDialog) still pending scheduling. Carry forward to TSK-153 review.

summary.verdict_rationale: All iter-1 findings addressed: F-01 closed (overflow-x-auto), F-03 closed (bg-transparent p-0), F-02 confirmed pre-existing out-of-scope (TSK-046), F-04 skipped out-of-scope. No new findings introduced. Design brief EP-020 compliance full. The Radix Tabs migration for TSK-143 is approved. Single carry-forward open question (OQ-03 / TSK-153) does not block this TSK.
